If every location is occupied, clear the selected active flag and play the removal cue. The loop reuses X as the respawn-list cursor, so its final no-location store uses that cursor.

phase1.evidence: Independent round2 decode and control/stack/bank review; analysis/disassembly/round002/review.md; redirect/round001-a/contracts.json and graph.json. Structural contract, natural reachability not asserted.

X is preserved through scratch rather than used as the scan cursor.
